deep_analysis:
3 open trades, all LONG, -0.08u unrealized, none armed yet (MFE < +0.40%).
The prior cycle's "sources AGREE" state is DECAYING but has not flipped.

MARKET: BTC pinned AT its own EMA300 (price 80671 vs ema300 80624, +0.06%,
consecutive_above 407 ticks ~6.8h, last below-close 14:51 UTC). regime_5m
long count faded 104L/2S/17N (17:45) -> 32L/10S/86N (18:15) in 30 min —
aggregate still LONG_BIAS, but half the longs evaporated. auto_trader still
CHOP/MANAGE_ONLY, volume_regime LOW, velocity SLOW, acceleration NEGATIVE.
Continuum's own fields disagree with each other (trend_quality STRONG_DOWN
vs linreg_direction LEAN_BULL vs price-above-EMA300) — treat phase fields as
unreliable again this cycle, same as last. Flip rate 19 agg / 18 BTC per 24h
= p50 normal band (16-22), NOT >=26 p95, NOT <6 trend tape.

TRADE-BY-TRADE (would-I-open-fresh test):
- #16395 BTC LONG continuum-trend+ (2.5h, +0.04%, RSI 58.2): WOULD OPEN
  FRESH. Family 7d 5T 80%WR +0.09, structure aligned (above EMA300 6.8h),
  15m+4h both LONG_BIAS. SL 79899 (-0.91%), arm 80960 — only 0.31% away
  at 80708. Its risk is not direction, it is never arming in LOW volume.
- #16399 KAS LONG bb-squeeze+ (0.7h, -0.31%, RSI 53.4): WOULD OPEN FRESH.
  Best coin in the book: regime_5m LONG_BIAS conf 89.3, +1.46%/80m, and
  bb-squeeze+ is the healthiest live family (7d 7T 71.4%WR +0.36u).
- #16400 ETH LONG hl_copy_trader (0.3h, -0.21%, RSI 47.7): MARGINAL —
  would NOT open fresh. ETH is NEUTRAL conf 57.6 (no tape of its own),
  hl_copy_trader is the weakest family in the open book (7d 3T 33.3%WR,
  14d book 36.4%), and it carries the tightest stop in the book
  (SL 2350.74 = -0.35% from entry) in a LOW-vol tape. Not thesis-broken —
  it is 20 minutes old and the system's arm/timeout guards cover it — but
  it is the position to cut first if regime_5m returns SHORT_BIAS.

WINNING-SIDE QUESTION, asked honestly: if these three lose, the winning
side was SHORT or no-trade — all three are mid-band longs (RSI 47.7/53.4/
58.2) entered into a LOW-volume tape that is fading (104->32 longs). That
is exactly the chop-entry cell that owns 83.5% of 7d gross loss. The
defense already in place is arm/timeout, not direction: each trade must
reach +0.40% MFE or its guard exits it. Do not pre-emptively panic-exit —
re-test the LONG_BIAS condition next cycle.

SIDES FIND: HL_COPY_TRADING_ENABLED = False at hermes_constants.py:3854
("master kill-switch — disabled until tested") but grep shows the constant
is referenced ONLY in hermes_constants.py — no script reads it. Meanwhile
HL_COPY_SIGNAL_*=True let #16400 open. Vestigial flag, not a live bug,
but either wire it up or delete it — a kill-switch nobody reads is a
false sense of coverage.

Direction still leans long but there is no force behind it — arm-timeout
(never reaching +0.40% MFE), not stop-outs, remains the dominant near-term
